# Enchanted Booth Co.

> Des Moines' most enchanted photo booth. Luxury photo booth rental for weddings, corporate events and parties across the Des Moines metro, based in Waukee & West Des Moines.

## Current Status (2026)
Open and booking weddings, parties and corporate events across the Des Moines, Iowa metro. By appointment, seven days a week. Operated by Enchanted PhotoBooth LLC.

## About
Enchanted Booth Co. is a luxury photo booth rental serving the Des Moines metro. Every booking includes a professional DSLR studio setup, studio lighting, your choice of backdrop, a curated prop collection, a friendly on-site attendant, free setup and breakdown, instant sharing by QR / text / email, and a full online gallery. The booth is designed to look like it belongs at your event, not like hauled-in equipment.

## Packages & Pricing
- Classic Booth: $499 for 2 hours. Perfect for graduation parties, cocktail hours and intimate gatherings.
- Signature Booth: $699 for 3 hours. The ultimate wedding and corporate party package, tailored to your style.
- Premium Booth: $899 for 4 hours. The luxury choice for large-scale galas, weddings and brand activations.
Add-ons: additional hours $100 / hour; VIP postcard upgrade +$75. Minimum rental is 2 hours.

## Travel
Complimentary travel is included with every package (30 miles from Waukee & West Des Moines; 40 miles on Premium). Beyond that: 30-60 miles $100, 60-120 miles $200, 120+ miles custom quote. All fees confirmed before booking.

## Booking
A 50% deposit secures your date (non-refundable, applicable to a reschedule subject to availability). Enchanted Booth Co. carries general liability insurance; a certificate of insurance is available on request.

## FAQ
### What types of events do you do photo booth rentals for?
Weddings, corporate events, holiday parties, birthdays, graduations and just about any celebration. See weddings, corporate events and parties.

### What is included with every photo booth package?
Every booking includes a professional DSLR studio setup, free delivery, setup and breakdown, a friendly on-site attendant, your choice of backdrop, props, instant sharing by QR, text and email, and a full online gallery. See the packages for what each tier adds.

### How much does it cost to rent a photo booth?
Packages start at $499 for 2 hours (Classic), $699 for 3 hours (Signature) and $899 for 4 hours (Premium). Additional hours are $100 each. See full packages and pricing.

### What is the minimum rental time?
The minimum rental time is 2 hours, which is our Classic package. You can add hours any time for $100 per hour.

### What does setup and the experience look like?
We arrive early to set the booth up before your guests arrive. The booth needs a standard power outlet and Wi-Fi for instant sharing. A friendly attendant stays for the whole event, and we handle breakdown at the end. Setup and breakdown time is not counted in your service hours.

### Is a deposit required, and what if we need to reschedule?
Yes. A 50% deposit secures your date, and your date is not reserved until it is received. We know plans change. Deposits are non-refundable but may be applied to a rescheduled date, subject to availability.

### Do you travel? Are there travel fees?
Yes, we travel for events across the Des Moines metro and beyond. Travel within 30 miles of Waukee / West Des Moines is complimentary (40 miles on Premium). Beyond that: 30 to 60 miles is $100, 60 to 120 miles is $200, and 120+ miles is a custom quote. All fees are confirmed before you book. See service areas.

### Are you insured?
Yes. Enchanted Booth Co. carries general liability insurance and can provide a certificate of insurance (COI) on request, which many venues require.
